sources.title: Llama Guard 4 model card
sources.evidence: Reports 12B total parameters, dense early-fusion architecture, pruning of Scout routed experts and routers, text/multiple-image classification, and text safety labels.

sources.title: Llama Guard 4 architecture and prompt format
sources.evidence: Documents text-plus-image classification; output is a safe/unsafe label and optional violated-category list. Prompt roles are user and assistant.

sources.title: Model.max_seq_length, exact Llama Guard 4 entry
sources.evidence: The exact llama_guard_4_12b branch returns 8192. This source is pinned to the current file revision, dated October 10, 2025.

sources.title: Sharing new open source protection tools and advancements in AI privacy and security
sources.evidence: April 29, 2025 announcement says Meta is releasing Llama Guard 4 alongside other protection tools that day.

sources.title: Llama Guard 4 12B LICENSE
sources.evidence: Exact model directory contains the Llama 4 Community License Agreement, incorporating the AUP; its April 5 effective date is not this classifier release date.

sources.title: Llama Guard 4 12B acceptable use policy
sources.evidence: The incorporated policy restricts multimodal license grants for EU-domiciled individuals and EU-based companies, with an exception for end users of incorporating products/services.

sources.title: Official Llama Guard 4 12B checkpoint file listing
sources.evidence: Lists the official named checkpoint, five safetensors weight shards, and processor/tokenizer/configuration files; weights are gated under the custom license.

sources.title: Official Llama Guard 4 checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Direct and browser requests returned HTTP 401. Configuration contents were not accessed, and no exact tensor-derived learned-parameter count is asserted.

sources.title: Meta Llama Guard 4 README
sources.evidence: Identifies the model as Meta Llama Guard 4, a fine-tuned Llama 4 model, and offers model/weights for researchers and commercial entities under its license.

name.note: Official checkpoint name, normalized for display.

developer.note: Meta releases and maintains the model.

family.note: Broad catalog family retained; the specialized line is Llama Guard 4, derived from Llama 4.

release_date.note: Original public release announcement; neither the base Llama 4 license date nor prerelease repository creation date.

open_weights.note: Official downloadable gated checkpoint under a custom license; open weights does not mean an unrestricted open-source license.

license.note: Exact license verified, including the incorporated acceptable-use policy and multimodal EU restriction/end-user exception.

parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal total in billions for the multimodal model. No exact storage-element aggregate is substituted for learned parameters.

active_parameters_b.note: No separate active count is defined. Dense architecture does not establish active=total, particularly across text-only and image processing.

architecture.note: Early-fusion Transformer; Scout routed experts and routers were pruned, leaving shared dense feedforward layers.

context_window.note: Meta explicitly sets the exact model maximum sequence length to 8192. Replaces unverified 163840; this is the documented sequence length, not an assertion about every extrapolated positional setting. Original HF config is gated.

modalities.note: Text-only or mixed text/multiple-image inputs; outputs textual safety labels. Image-only classification is not the documented task.

reasoning.note: The documented classification interface emits safety labels, with no disclosed dedicated reasoning mode. This does not prove a universal inability to reason.

tool_call.note: Code Interpreter Abuse classifies tool-related conversations. Native function-call generation is not documented; classification support is not evidence of native tool calling.

description.value: Dense multimodal safety classifier pruned from Llama 4 Scout, producing safety labels for text and image prompts and responses.
description.note: Summarizes the documented architecture, origin, modalities and classifier output without general-assistant claims.

patch.description: Dense multimodal safety classifier pruned from Llama 4 Scout, producing safety labels for text and image prompts and responses.
patch.notes: Meta reports nominal 12B total parameters for a dense early-fusion Transformer pruned from Scout. Active parameters are not separately defined. Meta’s model registry sets maximum sequence length to 8192; the original HF configuration was inaccessible. No exact tensor count is asserted. The classifier evaluates tool-related content, but native tool calling and a dedicated reasoning mode are not disclosed. Original release is April 29, 2025; the custom license incorporates multimodal EU restrictions with an end-user exception.

summary: Confirmed nominal 12B multimodal total, Meta attribution, original April 29 release and Llama 4 license. Set dense architecture and corrected documented context from 163840 to 8192. Kept active count unknown and cleared unsupported reasoning/tool-calling booleans; the tool-related safety category does not establish native tool calling.
